Trace, implement and test: leetcode41 first missing positive hashmap

Study exercise derived from this source. Explain the approach in your own words, work through an example, and identify edge cases. For code, implement your own version and discuss its time and space complexity.

Original source context
#include <algorithm>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_map>
#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

class Solution {
public:
    int firstMissingPositive(vector<int> &nums) {
        unordered_map<int, int> dict;
        long max = 0; // max: 最长连续区间的结束位置的值
        for (int k = 0; k < nums.size(); k++)
        {
            if (nums[k] > 0)
                dict[nums[k]] = 1;  /* 题意: 找没有出现的最小的正整数, 于是0和负数不用考虑 */
            if (nums[k] > max)
                max = nums[k];
        }
        long res = max + 1;
        for (long k = 1; k <= max; k++)
        {
            if (dict.count(k) == 0)
            {
                res = k;
                break;
            }
        }
        return res;
    }
};

// Test
int main()
{
    Solution sol;
    vector<int> nums = {3,4,-1,1};
    int res = sol.firstMissingPositive(nums);
    cout << res << endl;
    
    return 0;
}
